name: Asszorti
summary: Three-player Hungarian trick-taking game where the bid winner plays alone to win six tricks, using the talon and choosing trumps.
rules_text: Asszorti uses 36 cards (A,K,Q,J,10,9,8,7,6) for 3 players clockwise. Each player gets 11 cards (3+2+2+2+2) and 3 cards form a face-down talon. Auction: eldest first. Bids in order 3,2,1,hand. No jump bids. After a higher bid, earlier bidders may only say hold to equal or pass. Last bidder becomes declarer, may raise final contract. If contract is 3/2/1, declarer secretly draws that many from talon top, then discards equal cards face-down onto talon. Hand uses no talon. Declarer then names trumps (hearts, diamonds, clubs, spades, or no-trump) and may announce arrivazs, commitment to win last three tricks alone. Opponents may kontra game and/or arrivazs separately, revealing talon. Doubling escalates: rekontra, szubkontra, hirskontra, mordkontra (x32). Play: RHO of declarer leads. Must follow suit, trump if void, no need to win. Highest trump or highest of led suit wins trick, winner leads next. Declarer needs 6+ tricks; arrivazs needs last 3. Scores double independently.
rating_reason: Three-player bidding Preferansz-style, trump choice and talon.
